proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — there is no species_trait kind. The record wrapper (id, name, provenance, description, kind, mechanics) has no matching shape for species traits.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Dwarven Resilience is a species trait, not a spell, class feature, or mastery. types.ts has no SpeciesTraitRecord and UnitRecord does not include kind: "species_trait".

proposed_widenings.name: passive_trait family
proposed_widenings.justification: Species traits are always-on at character creation — no activation cost, no resource, no reset cadence. The existing ClassFeatureActivationMechanics forces activation + use_count + resetCadence onto every feature. A new family (e.g. passive_trait) is needed for permanent innate effects that grant resistance or modify rolls without any trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. — no activation, no uses, no rest reset.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance effect in species/passive mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: grant_resistance is a v4 atom but it appears nowhere in ClassFeatureEffect or any surface type accessible to non-mastery, non-spell units. The passive family needs a surface-level effect type that can carry grant_resistance with a damage type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to Poison damage.

proposed_widenings.name: permanent condition-scoped modify_roll_advantage
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ModifyRollAdvantageRider (used in mastery riders) requires count and expiresOn — it is an expiring on-hit rider, not a permanent passive effect. Dwarven Resilience's advantage has no expiry and is gated on a specific condition (Poisoned), not a bare RollKind. Neither the expiry model nor the absence of a condition filter is expressible in the current shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

notes: The primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. Even if that were added, two effect shapes are missing: (1) a non-expiring grant_resistance effect for the passive family, and (2) a permanent condition-scoped modify_roll_advantage (current shape models temporary on-hit riders only). The v4 atoms grant_resistance and modify_roll_advantage both exist in the taxonomy; what is missing is the surface type plumbing to carry them in a passive always-on species trait context.
